featured_reviews.name: Durgesh Vanole
featured_reviews.review_text:
Honest Experience – Non Payment Since August 2023

I had attached my Swift Dzire TourS car with Midtown Travel Studio (driver appointed by them) on a monthly basis after visiting their office in Feb 2023.

From the very beginning, I faced continuous payment delays, irrelevant deductions, & penalties linked to driver-related issues — every month’s dues required repeated follow-ups.

In Aug 2023, due to recurring losses, I withdrew my car with a proper 30-day written notice on email, which accepted by Midtown. Even after completing the notice period, they withheld my final two months’ dues, shifting penalties entirely onto me (the car owner) for toll & parking discrepancies caused by their own appointed driver — despite those expenses already being paid by me during the duty period. Midtown took no accountability as the vendor. Still, I cooperated & accepted all deductions in good faith, expecting closure.

My final settlement was Rs. 1,09,710 of which the July 2023 payment was released only on 21 Jan 2024 after bounced cheques & months of reminders, even though the corporate company had already paid my payments to them.

The Aug 2023 balance of Rs. 51,677 remains unpaid to this day (Oct 2025) despite multiple assurances, dishonoured cheques, a written repayment plan, & even a legal notice.

Calls blocked, emails/messages unanswered — Midtown’s casual attitude & repeated missed timelines have caused serious financial & mental stress.

All I expect is simple fairness — respect clients’ payments & release dues on time as per agreed terms.

Please do not rely solely on recent positive online reviews (many appearing from newly created profiles), ads, or office appearances.

My experience has been extremely disappointing, & I am still awaiting my rightful payment since Aug 2023.

Anyone considering attaching their vehicle here should carefully verify their payment history & settlement practices first.

(Note: This review is based solely on my documented personal experience & communication with Midtown Travel Studio.)
